SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 5499
Date 13 / 12 / 33.

December 13, 1933. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

PUBLIC SAFETY BUREAU TO TAKE CENSUS

A census is to be taken by the Bureau of Public Safety. In view of the tense situation arising from the rebellion in Fukien, severe punishment will be inflicted on persons failing to report an increase or decrease in their households.

Instructions have been issued by the Bureau of Public Safety to the police to continue for to-day the special precautions which have been in force for two days.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES ADOPTED BY THE CHINESE AUTHORITIES

Upon receipt of information to the effect that local communists would create disturbances on December 11 and 12, the Anniversary of Canton Uprising, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai instructed the Public Safety Bureau and the Peace Preservation Corps to adopt special precautions. The Settlement authorities were also requested to act in like manner.

In consequence of these precautionary measures no untoward incidents occurred.

The Municipality of Greater Shanghai also instructed the military and police authorities to adopt winter precautions, and to detail more policemen for duty at important intersections. Between midnight and 6 a.m. today vehicles and pedestrians were not allowed on the roads.

Yesterday Mayor Wu Te-chen made the following statement:
"The activities for the bandit suppression in Kiangsi are in progress and these bandits will be suppressed in the near future.
"Regarding the Fukien movement, definite steps will be taken by the Central authorities in the near future.
"During the present national crisis no activities which affect the good order of the community will be permitted and the people throughout the country should unite and support the Central authorities."

Yesterday a joint proclamation was issued by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commission and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai urging the residents not to believe the rumours spread by reactionary elements.

日期 1933年12月13日

1933年12月13日。晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

公安局将进行户口调查

公安局将进行户口调查。鉴于福建叛乱引发的紧张局势，凡不报家中人口增减者，将予以严惩。

公安局已指令警队今日继续执行已实施两天的特别预防措施。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

中国当局采取预防措施

获悉本地共产党人拟于12月11日及12日广州起义纪念日制造骚乱后，大上海市政府指令公安局及保安团采取特别预防措施。并请求租界当局采取同样行动。

由于这些预防措施，未发生意外事件。

大上海市政府还指令军警当局采取冬季防范措施，并在重要路口增派警力。今日午夜至上午6时，禁止车辆和行人上路。

昨日，市长吴铁城发表如下声明：
“江西剿匪行动正在进行中，匪徒将于近期被肃清。
“关于福建事变，中央当局将于近期采取明确步骤。
“在当前国家危机期间，任何影响社会良好秩序的活动均不被允许，全国民众应团结一致，支持中央当局。”

昨日，淞沪卫戍司令部与大上海市政府联合发布告示，呼吁居民不要相信反动分子散布的谣言。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 5499
Date 12 / 12 / 33

December 12, 1933. Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

OFFICE OF "LIVELIHOOD WEEKLY" SEARCHED BY FRENCH POLICE

Informed that the "Livelihood Weekly" printed
at 150 Rue Vallon, has published articles of a reactionary
nature, the French Police at once secured a search
warrant from the Second Shanghai Special District Court
and searched the office yesterday morning. Some 100
copies of the publication were seized and taken to the
Police Station.
As the people responsible for the publication
were not in Shanghai, no arrests were made.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

PRIVATE LETTER DELIVERY OFFICES TO CLOSE

According to the statement of a departmental
chief of the General Post Office, the Ministry of
Communications has ordered all private letter delivery
offices to close at the end of the year 1934, because
these offices affect the income of the Post Office.
Detailed measures to enforce the order will be devised
by the Chief of the Post Office and the Minister of
Communications.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

SPECIAL PRECAUTIONS ON THE ANNIVERSARY OF CANTON UPRISING.

The Municipality of Greater Shanghai recently
received a confidential report to the effect that the
radical elements in Shanghai will take advantage of the
Anniversary of the Canton Uprising on December 11 to create
disturbances. Consequently the Municipality immediately
instructed the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters, the Peace Preservation Corps of the
Municipality, the Bureau of Public Safety and the Peace
Maintenance Corps to adopt special precautionary measures
on that day. The Municipality also requested the S.M.P.
and the F.M.P. to co-operate.
Vehicles and pedestrians will not be allowed on
the streets at Pootung, Kiangwan, Chenju and the Central
Zone between 12.30 and 8 a.m. December 12.
Precautions were also adopted yesterday in the
International Settlement and the French Concession.
Fearing that the reactionary elements may postpone
their activities, the Chinese authorities will also adopt
precautions to-day.

日期 1933年12月12日

1933年12月12日。晨间译件

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

法警搜查《生活周刊》社

获悉位于华隆路150号印刷的《生活周刊》刊登了具有反动性质的文章，法国警察随即从上海第二特区地方法院取得搜查令，并于昨日上午对该社进行了搜查。查获该刊物约100份，并带往警察局。
由于该刊负责人不在上海，故未实施逮捕。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

私人信局即将关闭

据邮政总局某科室主管称，交通部已命令所有私人信局于1934年底关闭，因为这些信局影响了邮政局的收入。邮政总局局长与交通部部长将制定执行该命令的详细措施。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

广州起义纪念日的特别预防措施

大上海市政府近日收到一份机密报告，称上海的激进分子将利用12月11日广州起义纪念日制造骚乱。因此，市政府立即指令淞沪卫戍司令部、市保安团、公安局及保卫团在该日采取特别预防措施。市政府还请求上海公共租界警务处（S.M.P.）和法国租界警务处（F.M.P.）予以配合。
12月12日凌晨12时30分至上午8时，浦东、江湾、真如及中心区的街道禁止车辆和行人通行。
昨日，国际租界和法租界也采取了预防措施。
因担心反动分子可能推迟行动，中国当局今日也将采取预防措施。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 5499
December 12/12/33

Political (2)

Returned Overseas Chinese - left for Taichow

The twelve Chinese who returned from Japan
owing to the impossibility of doing business
there and who were staying in the Sing Zung Hotel,
Nantao, (Vide I.R. 9/12/33) left for Taichow by
s.s. "Chusan" at 6 p.m. December 11.

Anniversary of the Canton Uprising

Apart from a quantity of communist handbills being
scattered on roads in the Louza and Tootoo Road Districts,
the 6th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising on December 11
passed without any untoward incident.

Communist Propaganda - Court proceedings

Li Doong Shing ( 李同生 ) alias Dah Sieu ( 大少 )
and Zung Wong Sz ( 徐王氏 ) alias Doe Tsoh Ziang
( 杜作祥 ), who were arrested by the Municipal Police
on December 9 and 10 respectively in the Wayside District
(Vide I.R. 11/12/33), appeared before the Second Branch
Kiangsu High Court on December 11 when an application
for their extradition by the Chinese Authorities was
granted.

日期 1933年12月12日

政治类 (2)

归国华侨 - 前往台州

此前因在日本无法经商而回国、暂住南市新宗旅馆的十二名华人（参见1933年12月9日情报报告），已于12月11日下午6时乘“舟山”轮前往台州。

广州起义纪念日

除在老闸区及普陀路（原文为Tootoo，疑为Pootoo之误）一带道路上散发了大量共产党传单外，12月11日的广州起义六周年纪念日平安度过，未发生任何意外事件。

共产党宣传 - 法庭诉讼

李同生（别名大少）和徐王氏（别名杜作祥），分别于12月9日和10日在越界筑路地区被工部局警务处逮捕（参见1933年12月11日情报报告），于12月11日出庭江苏高等法院第二分院，中方当局提出的引渡申请获准。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 5499
Date 11 / 12 / 33

December 11, 1933. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

SPECIAL PRECAUTIONS BEING ENFORCED IN CHINESE TERRITORY
TO-DAY

To-day being the Anniversary of the Canton Uprising,
special precautions have been proclaimed by the Chinese
authorities. In anticipation of reactionary elements
distributing pamphlets and creating disturbances, the
number of post duty police has been doubled, pedestrians
will be searched, and the police of the Municipality will
cooperate with the police of the French Concession and the
International Settlement. Motor car patrols of the Public
Safety Bureau have been instructed to observe the movements
of reactionaries in Nantao and Chapei.

1933年12月11日。晨间译件。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

今日中国领土内实施特别预防措施

今日是广州起义纪念日，中国当局已宣布实施特别预防措施。为防范反动分子散发传单和制造骚乱，执勤警察人数加倍，将对行人进行搜身，且市公安局警察将与法租界及国际租界警察合作。公安局的汽车巡逻队已奉命观察南市和闸北反动分子的动向。

TRANSLATION

Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety
Secret Order No.402

The Bureau has received a secret order No.166
from the Soong Wu Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters
to the effect that at a joint meeting held by some 20
members of the Social Democratic Party, the Third Party,
and the Nationalist Party in Room No.227 Hsin Wei Tsong
Hotel (新惠中), Hankow Road, on November 30, it was
decided that they will unanimously stage a riot in
Shanghai on December 12, and also Order No.189 from
the same Authority giving the information that the
"Red" bandits will carry out a motor car procession and
create disturbances on the occasion of the Anniversary
of the Canton Uprising which falls on December 11.
The Divisions of this Bureau are hereby warned to instruct
detectives as well/constables to keep strict observation
in the vicinity of pieces of vacant ground in their
respective areas that can be used as rendezvous or
meeting places and to pay special attention to motor
car processions if there are any on December 11.
Persons who conduct reactionary activities are to be
arrested and sent to the Bureau for interrogation.

The Bureau has also been reported that communists
will stage demonstrations on December 13 when the Police
are expected to take a rest after diligent services
performed by them on December 11 and 12. Therefore
the same precautionary measures taken on December 11 and
12 are to be taken on December 13 in order that ruffians
will not be given opportunity to create disturbances.

The Chief of the Bureau of Public Safety
Weng Hung un.

（批：Please enculate message as drafted so that stations will be in the loop.）
pages.zh:
译文

上海市公安局
密令第402号

本局收到淞沪卫戍司令部密令第166号，内容如下：11月30日，社会民主党、第三党及国民党成员约20人在汉口路新惠中酒店227室举行联席会议，决定于12月12日在上海一致发动暴乱；另收到该当局第189号令，提供情报称“赤”匪将在12月11日广州起义纪念日之际进行汽车游行并制造骚乱。特此警告本局各科，指令侦探及巡捕严密监视各自辖区内可作为集合或会议地点的空地附近情况，并特别注意12月11日是否有任何汽车游行。从事反动活动的人员应予逮捕并送交本局审讯。

另据报告，共产党将于12月13日举行示威，届时警方预计将在12月11日和12日勤勉服务后休息。因此，12月13日应采取与12月11日和12日相同的预防措施，以免给流氓制造骚乱的机会。

公安局局长
翁洪恩（音译）

（批注：请按起草内容传阅此消息，以便各警署知晓。）

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D 37911）
Date December 8 1933

Subject (in full) The 6th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising - December 11.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pro-hwa Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

I forward herewith copies of five communist handbills
bearing on the forthcoming 6th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising
which falls on December 11, 1933. These leaflets, which came
into the possession of the Municipal Police through Agents
A-4267 and A-7138 on December 6, were issued by the Kiangsu
Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and the
Central Committee of the Communist Youth League.
According to information obtained by Agents A-2764
and A-8227, the local Chinese Communist Party has instructed
its various district branches and cells to intensify the
propaganda movement by the surreptitious dissemination of
handbills and the hoisting of red cloth banners bearing the
Soviet insignia and appropriate inscriptions relating to the
anniversary on shop fronts, trees and electric standards
during the early mornings of days preceding the December 11
Anniversary.
Despite the exhortations of the Chinese Communist
Party and Communist Youth League to the labouring masses to
declare a general strike and to stage street demonstrations
to commemorate the approaching event, it is unlikely that
demonstrations of any magnitude will take place. It can be
expected, however, that minor street demonstrations by small
parties of communist adherents will occur on December 11.
A further report containing definite information on possible
happenings to be expected on that date will be forwarded on
the eve of the anniversary.

Kuh Tao-hua
〔此处转录不清〕
Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期 1933年12月8日

主题（全称）广州起义六周年纪念——12月11日。

由督察顾国华（Kuh Pro-hwa）呈报 转呈人〔此处转录不清〕

兹随函附上五份关于即将于1933年12月11日到来的广州起义六周年纪念的共产党传单副本。这些传单系中国共产党江苏省委员会和中国共产主义青年团中央委员会所印发，并于12月6日由密探A-4267和A-7138获取后交至本警务处。
根据密探A-2764和A-8227获得的情报，当地中国共产党已指示其各区分部和细胞组织，在12月11日纪念日前几天的清晨，通过秘密散发传单以及在商店门面、树木和电线杆上悬挂带有苏维埃标志和适当纪念题词的红色布旗，来加强宣传运动。
尽管中国共产党和共产主义青年团号召劳苦大众宣布总罢工并举行街头示威以纪念这一即将到来的事件，但不太可能发生任何大规模的示威活动。然而，可以预料的是，12月11日当天会出现由小股共产党追随者进行的轻微街头示威。一份包含对该日可能发生的事件的明确信息的进一步报告，将在纪念日前夕呈报。

顾道华（Kuh Tao-hua）
〔此处转录不清〕
特科主管警官。

（左侧页边批注：附件 mi 1.P. of 9/12/33 HK. and P.O.? telephones to my personal contact JR. 〔此处转录不清〕）

pages.en:
SUNRISED TRANSLATION OF COMMUNIST BROADSHEET ENTITLED
"MANIFESTO IN COMMEMORATION OF THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE CANTON
UPRISING AND SUPPORT OF THE SECOND NATIONAL CONGRESS OF SOVIET
REPRESENTATIVES", ISSUED BY THE KIANGSU PROVINCIAL COMMITTEE
OF THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY AND DATED DECEMBER 11, 1933.

To the toiling masses throughout the country,

To-day is the 6th anniversary of the Canton Uprising
which resulted in the establishment of the first Soviet regime in
China and the disclosure of the atrocities committed by the ruling
classes.

The present anniversary of the Canton Uprising is marred
by the imperialistic Kuomintang which is madly engaged in the 5th
Anti-Communist Campaign to massacre labouring and peasant masses.
The foreign imperialists have become more energetic in their
endeavours to partition China and the Kuomintang is clearing the
way for the foreign imperialists in a most subservient manner.
China has therefore only two ways before her, to be Colonized
or Sovietized. On the day of the anniversary the Second National
Congress of Soviet Representatives will be convened and for this
reason we may say that the anniversary this year is of special
significance.

At the time of the Canton Uprising the Kuomintang, under
the protection of imperialistic gunboats (? foreign gunboats),
massacred 8,000 labourers and peasants in Canton during a period
of three days. That, however, was only the beginning of the White
Terrorism of the Kuomintang and since then the Kuomintang has
intensified "White Terrorism" and the massacre of labourers and
peasants. In "White territory" (Territory under Kuomintang control)
the Kuomintang resorts to measures such as abduction, cruel torture,
burial of people alive, wholesale massacre, etc., in dealing with
labouring and peasant masses and other revolutionary elements. As
regards Soviet areas, the Kuomintang mobilizes all its reactionary
forces to butcher labourers and peasants by using heavy guns,
aeroplanes and gas. In exchange for financial assistance and
firearms, the Kuomintang has surrendered the nation to the
imperialistic countries and betrayed the people of their territorial
and other rights.
pages.zh:
对中国共产党江苏省委员会印发、日期为1933年12月11日、题为《纪念广州起义周年及拥护第二次全国苏维埃代表大会宣言》的共产党传单的译文（SUNRISED译）。

致全国劳苦大众，

今天是广州起义六周年纪念日，这次起义导致了中国第一个苏维埃政权的建立，并揭露了统治阶级的暴行。

当前的广州起义周年纪念日被帝国主义国民党所破坏，该党正疯狂地进行第五次“剿共”运动，屠杀劳苦工农大众。外国帝国主义者在瓜分中国的企图上变得更加积极，而国民党则以最奴颜婢膝的方式为外国帝国主义者们扫清道路。因此，中国面前只有两条路：要么被殖民化，要么苏维埃化。在纪念日当天，第二次全国苏维埃代表大会将召开，因此我们可以说，今年的周年纪念具有特殊的意义。

在广州起义期间，国民党在帝国主义炮舰（？外国炮舰）的庇护下，在三天内于广州屠杀了8,000名工人和农民。然而，那只是国民党白色恐怖的开端，此后国民党加剧了“白色恐怖”以及对工人和农民的屠杀。在“白区”（国民党控制区域），国民党采取绑架、酷刑折磨、活埋、大规模屠杀等手段来对付劳苦工农大众和其他革命分子。至于苏维埃地区，国民党动员其所有反动力量，使用重炮、飞机和毒气来屠戮工人和农民。为了换取财政援助和武器，国民党向帝国主义国家出卖了国家，背叛了人民的领土权和其他权利。

pages.en:
The Kuomintang, even with the direct assistance of
imperialistic countries, has no hope of success in its 5th
anti-communist campaign, because the armed forces of the Chinese
labouring and peasant masses are undefeatable when facing
Kuomintang troops. The peasant and labouring masses have
established their own Soviet Government which has at least one-
fourth of the whole population under its control. Workers in
Soviet areas are enjoying an 8-hour working day and their wages
are increased and their working hours reduced from time to time.
Unemployment becomes less and less as time goes on; all peasants
are given land; there is no outrageous taxation and there is
only one tax which is the progressive tax; poor peasants are
completely exempted from taxes; members of Red armies are also
given land and other benefits; females are free from the
bondage of the old social system and female workers are given
the same pay and work as male workers and also other special
treatment. All these are contrary to the existing conditions
in territory under Kuomintang control where peasants, labourers
and poor people are subject to continuous reduction of pay and
increase of working hours, unemployment, loss of land, poverty,
starvation, exile, and death.

The Provisional Central Government of the Soviet Republic
of China has decided to convene the Second National Congress of
Soviet Representatives on December 11 in order to absorb new labour
and peasant elements into the government with a view to strengthen-
ing the Soviet movement.

The Soviet area in Szechuen has extended to more than 20
Hsiens and the Red Armies in the centre of Kiangsi have gained
numerous victories. Therefore the end of the Kuomintang rule is
near. The so-called "People's Government" in Fukien is simply
a combination of Kuomintang militarists - Li Chi Sung and Chen
Ming Chu, etc. - and the Third Party, which has long been despised
by labouring and peasant masses. The Fukien Government is not
a government that labourers and peasants are in need of, it is
pages.zh:
即使在帝国主义国家的直接协助下，国民党的第五次“剿共”运动也没有成功的希望，因为中国劳苦工农大众的武装力量在面对国民党军队时是不可战胜的。工农大众已经建立了自己的苏维埃政府，其控制的人口至少占全国总人口的四分之一。苏维埃地区的工人享有八小时工作制，他们的工资不时增加，工作时间不时减少。失业现象随着时间的推移越来越少；所有农民都分得了土地；没有苛捐杂税，只有一种税，即累进税；贫农完全免税；红军战士也分得土地并享受其他福利；妇女从旧社会制度的束缚中解放出来，女工享有与男工相同的薪酬和工作待遇，以及其他特殊待遇。所有这些都与国民党控制区域的现状相反，在那里的农民、工人和穷人遭受着工资不断降低、工作时间增加、失业、失地、贫困、饥饿、流离失所和死亡的苦难。

中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府决定于12月11日召开第二次全国苏维埃代表大会，以便吸收新的工农分子进入政府，从而加强苏维埃运动。

四川的苏维埃区域已扩展到二十多个县，江西中部的红军取得了无数胜利。因此，国民党统治的终结近在咫尺。福建所谓的“人民政府”仅仅是国民党军阀——李济深和陈铭枢等人——以及长期被劳苦工农大众所鄙视的第三党的结合体。福建政府并不是工农所需要的政府，它是

pages.en:
-3-

simply an offshoot of the Kuomintang. The Japanese imperialists
will now occupy Fukien just as they have occupied Northern
China and will directly assist the Kuomintang to attack the
Red Armies. It is the time for our labouring and peasant
masses to unite under the Chinese Soviet Flag and carry
out the revolutionary civil war.

The following are our slogans :-

Commemorate the Canton Uprising and celebrate the Second
National Congress of Soviet Representatives by holding meetings,
demonstrations and declaring strikes!
Support the Congress and the Soviet Government!
Contribute funds to the Red Armies and organize "Red Army
Friendly Societies" and "Soviet Friendly Societies"!
Oppose the surrender of the nation by the Kuomintang to the
imperialists and oppose the sale of national rights!
Oppose the recognition of "Manchukuo"!
Oppose the 5th Anti-Communist Campaign of the Kuomintang!
Oppose the White Terrorism of the Kuomintang Fascisti!
Continue in the spirit of the Canton Uprising and carry out
struggles against imperialism, capitalism and the Kuomintang!
Strive for freedom of speech, assembly, organization and press!
Long live the Canton Uprising!
Long live the Second National Congress of Soviet Representatives!
Long live Soviet China!

Kiangsu Provincial Committee
of the
Chinese Communist Party.

--

Dated 11.12.33.
pages.zh:
-3-

仅仅是国民党的一个分支。日本帝国主义者现在将像占领华北一样占领福建，并将直接协助国民党进攻红军。现在是我们劳苦工农大众在中国苏维埃旗帜下团结起来，进行革命内战的时候了。

以下是我们的口号：

通过举行集会、示威和宣布罢工来纪念广州起义并庆祝第二次全国苏维埃代表大会！
拥护代表大会和苏维埃政府！
为红军捐款，组织“红军之友社”和“苏维埃之友社”！
反对国民党向帝国主义出卖国家，反对出卖国权！
反对承认“满洲国”！
反对国民党的第五次“剿共”运动！
反对国民党法西斯的白色恐怖！
发扬广州起义精神，开展反对帝国主义、资本主义和国民党的斗争！
争取言论、集会、结社和出版自由！
广州起义万岁！
第二次全国苏维埃代表大会万岁！
苏维埃中国万岁！

中国共产党
江苏省委员会。

--

日期 1933年12月11日。

pages.en:
SUBLIMID TRANSLATION OF A COMMUNIST REBELLION MANIFESTO
"SIGNS TO BE USED IN COMMEMORATION OF THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE
CANTON UPRISING", ISSUED BY THE KIANGSU PROVINCIAL COMMITTEE OF
THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY AND DATED DECEMBER 11, 1933.

Labourers and Peasants, arise and commemorate the Anniversary
of the Canton Uprising!

The Canton Uprising was the first "banner" of the Chinese
Soviet!

The Canton Uprising was the vanguard of the Chinese Soviet
Movement and of the Red Army!

Support the Chinese Soviet Government and the Labourers and
Peasants' Red Army and commemorate the Anniversary of the Canton
Uprising!

Support the Second National Congress of Soviet Representatives
and make drastic efforts to elect representatives to the congress!

Oppose the 5th Bandit Suppression Campaign launched by the
Kuomintang; oppose the aerial bombardment of Soviet areas by the
Kuomintang; oppose the surrender of the Kuomintang to the
Imperialists and the betrayal of the people's interests; oppose
the direct negotiations between China and Japan; oppose the
official recognition of Manchukuo, the resumption of postal and
train services with Manchukuo and the establishment of revenue
offices in the vicinity of the Great Wall!

Oppose the partitioning of China by foreign imperialists!

Oppose the "White Terror" of the Kuomintang to massacre the
revolutionary elements of labourers and peasants; oppose the
atrocities of the Fascists in depriving the people of their
freedom!

Oppose the "People's Government" of Fukien which is deceiving
the labourers and peasants; the Soviet alone can show the way-out
to the Chinese labourers and peasants!

Oppose attacks by capitalists, the dismissal of workers, the
reduction of wages and the suspension of operations in factories!

Oppose the suppression of labourers' struggles and strikes;
oppose the betrayal of labourers' interests by the running dogs
of 'Yellow' labour unions!

Oppose outrageous taxation by the Kuomintang as well as its
press-gang policy!

Commence struggles by famine sufferers in winter; seize rice
from shops; make free distribution of food and confiscate
Japanese goods!

Hold meetings, declare a general strike and stage demonstrations
to commemorate the December 11 Anniversary!

Act according to the experience gained in the Canton
Uprising!

Long live the Canton Uprising; long live the Second National
Congress of Soviet Representatives; and long live the Chinese
Soviet!

Kiangsu Provincial Committee
of the
Chinese Communist Party.
pages.zh:
对中国共产党江苏省委员会印发、日期为1933年12月11日、题为《纪念广州起义周年所用标语》的共产党叛乱宣言的译文（SUBLIMID译）。

工人和农民们，奋起纪念广州起义周年！

广州起义是中国苏维埃的第一面“旗帜”！

广州起义是中国苏维埃运动和红军的先锋！

拥护中国苏维埃政府和工农红军，纪念广州起义周年！

拥护第二次全国苏维埃代表大会，并大力努力选举代表参加大会！

反对国民党发动的第五次“剿匪”运动；反对国民党对苏维埃地区的空中轰炸；反对国民党向帝国主义投降及背叛人民利益；反对中日直接谈判；反对正式承认满洲国、恢复与满洲国的邮政和铁路服务以及在长城附近设立税务机构！

反对外国帝国主义瓜分中国！

反对国民党屠杀工农革命分子的“白色恐怖”；反对法西斯剥夺人民自由的暴行！

反对欺骗工农的福建“人民政府”；只有苏维埃才能为中国工农指出出路！

反对资本家的攻击、解雇工人、降低工资和工厂停工！

反对镇压工人的斗争和罢工；反对“黄色”工会走狗背叛工人利益！

反对国民党的苛捐杂税及其抓壮丁政策！

开展冬季饥民斗争；夺取商店里的米粮；免费分发食物并没收日货！

举行集会，宣布总罢工并举行示威，以纪念12月11日周年！

按照广州起义中获得的经验行动！

广州起义万岁；第二次全国苏维埃代表大会万岁；中国苏维埃万岁！

中国共产党
江苏省委员会。

TRANSLATION OF A COMMUNIST HANDBILL DATED NOVEMBER 23, 1933, and
ENTITLED "MANIFESTO ADDRESSED TO THE TOILING YOUNG MASS IN
COMMEMORATION OF THE 6TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE CANTON UPRISING",
ISSUED BY THE CENTRAL COMMITTEE OF THE CHINESE COMMUNIST YOUTH
LEAGUE.

To the toiling youths throughout the country:

The 6th Anniversary of the Canton Commune and the
opening of the Second National Congress of Soviet
Representatives will fall on December 11 this year.

On December 11, 1927, the peasants and soldiers,
led by the Chinese proletariat, overthrew by armed
uprising, the evil Kuomintang rule and replaced it with
a Soviet regime of the people. This was the first
movement of independence and emancipation proclaimed in
China, whereby all unequal treaties were abolished, all
properties of Kuomintang officials and landlords confiscated,
the 8-hour working system enforced and an armed Red Army
organized.

The Canton Commune, however, existed only for
two and half days for it suffered suppression at the hands
of the Kuomintang with the assistance of the imperialists.
The Kuomintang savagely killed thousands of the toiling
masses, mostly juvenile workers, set fire to the Soviet
Consulate, murdered Soviet consular officials and even
slandered the Soviet Union, the supporter of the Chinese
Revolution.

The Canton Commune has revealed that the overthrow
of the Kuomintang rule and the establishment of Soviet
regime may be carried out only by labourers and peasants
under the leadership of the proletariat.

With the approach of the 6th Anniversary of the
Canton Commune, the toiling young masses throughout the
country should be guided by the sanguinary experiences
in the Canton Uprising and struggle in conjunction with the
Red Army for the successful organization of a Soviet China
and to realize the unfulfilled ambitions of the thousands
of warriors who were killed during the incident in Canton.
pages.zh:
对日期为1933年11月23日、题为《致劳苦青年大众纪念广州起义六周年宣言》的共产党传单的译文，由中国共产主义青年团中央委员会印发。

致全国劳苦青年：

广州公社六周年纪念日及第二次全国苏维埃代表大会的开幕将于今年12月11日到来。

1927年12月11日，在中国无产阶级的领导下，农民和士兵通过武装起义推翻了邪恶的国民党统治，并以人民的苏维埃政权取而代之。这是在中国宣布的第一个独立和解放运动，据此废除了所有不平等条约，没收了国民党官员和地主的所有财产，实行了八小时工作制，并组建了武装红军。

然而，广州公社仅存在了两天半，因为它在帝国主义的协助下遭到了国民党的镇压。国民党残忍地杀害了数千名劳苦大众，其中大多是青年工人，纵火焚烧苏联领事馆，谋杀苏联领事官员，甚至诽谤支持中国革命的苏联。

广州公社揭示出，推翻国民党统治和建立苏维埃政权，只能由无产阶级领导下的工人和农民来完成。

随着广州公社六周年纪念日的临近，全国劳苦青年大众应以广州起义的血腥经验为指导，与红军联合斗争，为成功组建苏维埃中国而奋斗，以实现成千上万在广州事件中牺牲的战士未竟的志向。

pages.en:
SPECIAL TRANSLATION OF A DOCUMENT ENTITLED
"OPEN LETTER TO THE TOILING YOUTHS IN CONNECTION WITH THE
6TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE CANTON UPRISING," ISSUED BY THE
KIANGSU PROVINCIAL COMMITTEE OF THE CHINESE COMMUNIST
YOUTH LEAGUE, DATED DECEMBER 11, 1933.

To young labourers, peasants, soldiers and other revolutionary
youths in Kiangsu:-

The anniversary of the glorious Canton uprising is again
approaching.

On this date six years ago the Chinese toiling masses,
led by the proletarian classes, overthrew, by force of arms, the
reactionary Kuomintang rule in Canton and established in its
place a Soviet regime. For the first time, the flag of the
labouring and peasant masses was hoisted in China. Although
the Soviet regime in Canton was suppressed by the savage white
terror of the imperialistic Kuomintang after an existence
lasting three days, nevertheless during this short period of time
it had proclaimed the Soviet laws, enforced an 8-hour working
system, confiscated the banks as well as the properties of the
imperialistic Kuomintang and capitalists and brought emancipation
and freedom to all labourers, peasants and toiling masses.

The Canton Uprising has impressed upon the Chinese toiling
masses that the Soviet is the channel of salvation and that under
the guidance of the proletariat and by means of armed uprising,
they will secure emancipation.

This year's anniversary of the Canton Uprising coincides
with the opening of the Second National Congress of Soviet
Representatives. The Red flag is flying over many places in
China such as Kiangsi, Fukien, Hunan, Hupeh, Honan, Szechuen,
Shensi and Kansu and hundreds of thousands of toiling masses have
been liberated from Kuomintang oppression and are now enjoying
improved living conditions under a Soviet regime.

The Kuomintang is massacring Chinese toiling youths and
attacking the Chinese Soviet Red Army more cruelly than it did
in 1927. It has betrayed the nation to Japan and other
imperialists and has launched a 5th suppression campaign against
the Red Army.

On the anniversary of the Canton Uprising, the toiling
pages.zh:
题为《为广州起义六周年致劳动青年公开信》的文件特别译文，由中国共产党江苏省委员会于1933年12月11日发布。

致江苏的年轻劳工、农民、士兵及其他革命青年：

光荣的广州起义周年纪念日再次临近。

六年前的这一天，中国劳苦大众在无产阶级阶级的领导下，以武力推翻了国民党在广州的反动统治，并建立了苏维埃政权。在中国，劳动和农民大众的旗帜第一次被升起。虽然广州的苏维埃政权在存在三天后，被帝国主义国民党的残酷白色恐怖所镇压，但在这短短的时间内，它颁布了苏维埃法律，实行八小时工作制，没收了银行以及帝国主义国民党和资本家的财产，使所有劳工、农民和劳苦大众获得了解放和自由。

广州起义给中国劳苦大众留下了深刻印象，即苏维埃是救赎的途径，在无产阶级的指导下，通过武装起义，他们将获得解放。

今年的广州起义周年纪念日恰逢第二次全国苏维埃代表大会开幕。红旗正在中国的许多地方飘扬，如江西、福建、湖南、湖北、河南、四川、陕西和甘肃，成千上万的劳苦大众已从国民党的压迫下解放出来，现在在苏维埃政权下享受着改善的生活条件。

国民党屠杀中国劳动青年，并比1927年更残酷地攻击中国苏维埃红军。它背叛国家给日本和其他帝国主义者，并对红军发动了第五次围剿战役。

在广州起义周年纪念日之际，劳动

pages.en:

masses should observe the following slogans:-

1) Cease work, for ing, drilling and study to commemorate
the anniversary!

2) Stage processions and demonstration on that day!

3) Celebrate the Second National Congress of Soviet
Representatives!

4) Oppose the White Terror of the Kuomintang Fascist!

Kiangsu Provincial Committee
of the
Chinese Communist Youth League,
December 11, 1933.

pages.en:
SUMMARIZED TRANSLATION OF A COMMUNIST HANDBILL ENTITLED "MANIFESTO
IN COMMEMORATION OF THE CANTON UPRISING AND IN CELEBRATION OF THE
SECOND NATIONAL CONGRESS OF SOVIET REPRESENTATIVES," ISSUED BY THE
PROPAGANDA SECTION OF THE SHANGHAI EASTERN DISTRICT COMMITTEE OF
THE CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY.

To dear labour friends and other oppressed masses,

The Anniversary of the Canton Uprising is approaching!

It was on December 11, 1927, that the toiling masses in Canton,
unable any longer to bear the oppression and massacre at the hands
of the capitalists, started an armed uprising and overthrew the
capitalistic regime, replacing it with a Soviet Government of their
own. Although this revolution was suppressed three days later, its
great significance shall remain for ever. This uprising introduced
revolutionary influence into China. Two years ago Ju-king, Kiangse,
was made the seat of the Chinese Soviet Government, under whose
leadership 100,000,000 toiling people have been liberated from the
yoke of the imperialistic Kuomintang.

To-day is the 6th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising.
It is also the Opening of the Second National Congress of Soviet
Representatives.

Labour friends, we must not forget that we are the enemies
of anti-revolutionaries. We should unite, declare strikes and
stage demonstrations to commemorate the Anniversary of the Canton
Uprising and to celebrate the Second National Congress of Soviet
Representatives.

Propaganda Section
of the
Eastern District Committee
of the
Chinese Communist Party.
pages.zh:
题为《纪念广州起义及庆祝第二次全国苏维埃代表大会宣言》的共产党传单摘要译文，由中国共产党上海东区委员会宣传部发布。

致亲爱的劳工朋友及其他受压迫群众，

广州起义周年纪念日即将来临！

1927年12月11日，广州的劳苦大众因无法再忍受资本家的压迫和屠杀，发动武装起义，推翻了资本主义政权，取而代之的是他们自己的苏维埃政府。虽然这场革命在三天后被镇压，但其伟大意义将永存。这次起义将革命影响引入中国。两年前，江西瑞金成为中国苏维埃政府的所在地，在其领导下，一亿劳苦人民已从帝国主义国民党的枷锁中解放出来。

今天是广州起义六周年纪念日。
这也是第二次全国苏维埃代表大会的开幕之日。

劳工朋友们，我们不要忘记我们是反革命分子的敌人。我们应该团结起来，宣布罢工并举行为纪念广州起义周年和庆祝第二次全国苏维埃代表大会的示威活动。

中国共产党
东区委员会
宣传部。

pages.en:
Translation of Letter No.97 dated December 6, 1933
from the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau

Police Headquarters,
S. M. P.

According to confidential report local communists
have decided to mobilize all adherents and make their
appearance in the form of "Light Cavalry Groups" in Chapei
and Nantao under the pretext of letting off balloons on the
6, 7, 8th inst. Really they will disseminate handbills and
stir up disturbances.

It is further learned that in the event of no
satisfactory results being obtained during these three days
and in order to eventually crown their efforts with success,
local 'Red' adherents will continue their activities on the
9th, 10th, 11th, 12th and 13th inst, emphasis being laid on
the 11th, Anniversary of Canton Uprising, on which date they
will intensify their propaganda and precipitate demonstrations.

Apart from reporting to my superiors and addressing
those concerned, I have to inform you of the above and shall
be glad if you will kindly instruct your subordinates to take
precaution and to effect arrest of those found disturbing peace
and good order.

Wen Hung-en,
Chief of Public Safety Bureau.
pages.zh:
上海公安局1933年12月6日
第97号信函译文

警察总局，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

据机密报告，当地共产党人已决定动员所有追随者，借口于本月6日、7日、8日在闸北和南市放飞气球，以“轻骑兵组”的形式出现。实际上，他们将散发传单并煽动骚乱。

另获悉，如果在这三天内未能取得满意结果，为了最终取得成功，当地“赤色”追随者将在本月9日、10日、11日、12日和13日继续其活动，重点放在11日，即广州起义周年纪念日，当天他们将加强宣传并引发示威活动。

除向上级报告并致函有关方面外，特此告知上述情况，如蒙指示下属采取预防措施，并逮捕被发现扰乱治安者，不胜感激。

温雄恩，
公安局局长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Despatch bearing Character TING No. 89 from the Bureau of Public Safety of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.

December 3, 1933.

Confidential.

To
Messrs. Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sirs,

The Privy Chamber of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai has transmitted to us a copy of the following communication from the General Office of the Military Affairs Committee:-

"According to a report, the Communists have decided to organize a "Red Flag Movement Society" in commemoration of the anniversary of the Canton Uprising in 1927 ten days in advance. Meantime, every branch party office in each section has been ordered to select three groups for the purpose of disseminating red flags. Each group will prepare ten such flags and the method of hoisting them is to tie a piece of stone with a piece of hemp string to a corner of the flag and throw them up on to a wire by the roadway in all congested centres. For your information and attention please".

In consequence of the foregoing, I, apart from ordering my subordinates to detail "plain clothes" to detect and to take any persons who are found to either disseminate or hoist red flags into custody, and notify the parties concerned, I request that you take note and instruct the men under your command to be on the alert please.

**〔此处转录不清〕**

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
S.2, Spec
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. ... No. D ... Date Branch Shanghai,）
Date November 27, 1935.

Subject (in full) Instructions issued by the Chinese Communist Party in connection with the 6th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising - December 11.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

Agents A-2237 and A-3250 report that the Headquarters of the local Chinese Communist Party recently issued the following instructions to its various subsidiary district committees in connection with the intensification of the propaganda movement scheduled to take place prior to the occasion of the 6th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising, which falls on December 11 :-

Instructions to District Committees

(1) All "Cells" under the control of District Committees to prepare at least three red cloth banners bearing the Soviet insignia, size about 12" x 18", and to detail members to display them on shop fronts, trees and electric standards in their respective areas. Persons undertaking this work will be referred to as members of the "Red Banner Group."

(2) District Committees should despatch "Propaganda Groups" to the neighbourhood of labourers' dormitories to expound communist propaganda on the significance of the forthcoming anniversary on the following lines :-

a) Opposition to the "White Terror" methods employed by the Chinese Fascists.
b) Support people's anti-Imperialist movements.
c) Rescue anti-Fascist and anti-Imperialist warriors.
d) Investigate and disclose the treacherous policy of the Kuomintang and eliminate the traitors of the people.
e) Solicit contributions to buy comforts for the members of the "Dog Beating Groups" (Assassination Corps) at present detained in custody by the Municipal Police.

（左侧批注：S. 2. Return a relevant memorandum with anything additional which may come to hand. [签名]）

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期 1935年11月27日。

主题（全称）中国共产党就12月11日广州起义六周年发布的指示。

由特别股督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao-hwa）制作 转发 [签名]

特工 A-2237 和 A-3250 报告称，当地中国共产党总部最近就加强定于12月11日广州起义六周年纪念日前进行的宣传活动，向其各下属区委员会发布了以下指示：

给区委员会的指示

(1) 受区委员会控制的所有“细胞”至少准备三面带有苏维埃标志的红布横幅，尺寸约为12英寸 x 18英寸，并指派成员在各自区域的店面、树木和电线杆上展示它们。从事此项工作的人将被称为“红旗组”成员。

(2) 区委员会应派遣“宣传组”前往劳工宿舍附近，按以下方针阐述即将到来的周年纪念日的共产主义宣传意义：

a) 反对中国法西斯分子采用的“白色恐怖”手段。
b) 支持人民的反帝运动。
c) 营救反法西斯和反帝国主义战士。
d) 调查并揭露国民党的叛国政策，清除人民公敌。
e) 募集捐款，为目前被工部局警务处拘留的“打狗组”（暗杀团）成员购买慰问品。

（左侧批注：S. 2. 如有其他补充材料到手，请退回相关备忘录。[签名]）

顾宝华
特别股督察
特别股主管。
